_about: Hand-written from today's code, never captured: what GET /subway/stations/<id>/arrivals answered in ko, en and zh at 00:20 and 02:00 KST on Wednesday 2026-10-21 (service day Tuesday 2026-10-20), timetable only, over the subway-topology characterization's seed (every arrival state 14 h old) and the committed timetables, generated 2026-10-20 at commit 46c6ea60, before the topology reader landed. Each answer keeps its status, Cache-Control, Vary, ETag and body; the body's bytes are JSON.stringify of it. Changed 2026-10-23 with the behavior it pins, no other value changed: each station gained its coords from revision 1 of subway-station-coords, and each ETag was recomputed from the new bytes.
